checks.name: Session creation and anonymous state use the expected shape and private cookie
A participant or incorrect host key cannot control the presentation
Authorized slide and blackout controls synchronize, with invalid commands rejected
Response validation rejects empty, conflicting, duplicate, invalid and overlong inputs
A first response is counted and the requested Codex/negated-Claude example is correct
Editing the same browser response replaces selections and text without an extra participant
Different browsers count separately, synonyms group and frequency reflects people
Full experience text is returned only to the authorized host
The presenter pauses and resumes participation, and the API enforces the pause
Unknown or malformed room codes return a clear missing-session response
